name: vllm_gather_and_maybe_dequant_cache
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_gather_and_maybe_dequant_cache.py. Gathers per-token entries from a paged src_cache (num_blocks,block_size,num_heads,head_dim=576) fp16 into dst (num_tokens,num_heads,head_dim); kv_cache_dtype='auto' so no dequant. In-place op: dst is allocated inside run() and returned. block_table (batch,2) int32 in [0,num_blocks), cu_seq_lens int32, token_to_seq int32 (repeat_interleave of arange(batch)), and scale=[1.0] fp32 are built in gen_inputs; src_cache is plain random; num_tokens and kv_cache_dtype are scalars; seq_starts is passed as None inside run. No torch fallback; requires vLLM at eval time.
